messages:
support_julia: FYI — pen engagement sent a finding: KMS GenerateDataKey events in our CloudTrail export are missing TTL/audit fields (appear as TTL=0). Pen flagged as potential data-retention breach. Attaching their exported sample.

raj_sre: linking the export would help. can you paste the exact lines they saw?

support_julia: https://redwood.internal/pen/reports/2145678901/kms-export-snippet.log — small snippet pasted below

maria_infosec: is this coming from the CloudTrail raw events or from our exporter that writes to the security bucket?

support_julia: cloudtrail -> s3 -> our kms-audit-exporter -> security bucket. pen pulled from security bucket.

dev_oleg: heads up i shipped a tiny change to the exporter on 2026-03-01 08:55 UTC to drop null/empty fields to save space. code excerpt:
```python
# previous behavior: include zeros
if value is None:
    continue
# new change accidentally dropped zero-valued fields too
if not value:
    continue
```

raj_sre: that difference could make numeric TTL 0 drop entirely. i'll fetch the raw CloudTrail event. command i'm running:
`aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=GenerateDataKey --start-time 2026-03-01T08:50:00Z --end-time 2026-03-01T09:10:00Z`

raj_sre: sample raw event pasted:
{"eventTime":"2026-03-01T08:57:12Z","eventName":"GenerateDataKey","requestParameters":{"KeyId":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd","EncryptionContext":{},"GrantTokens":null},"additionalEventData":{},"userIdentity":{...},"responseElements":{"PlaintextLength":32,"PlaintextTTL":0}}

maria_infosec: responseElements shows PlaintextTTL=0 in raw event — if exporter dropped 0 fields, the security export would not include TTL, which the pen team interpreted as missing retention. This is a compliance bad signal.

dev_oleg: opened PR to revert behavior: PR #1024 — set `drop_zero_fields=false` by default, added a test to ensure 0 is preserved.

sec-bot: automated note: ticket SEC-2145678901 created for remediation tracking.

maria_infosec: action plan proposal:
- hotfix exporter config to preserve zero values (owner: dev_oleg)
- deploy canary to security bucket pipeline (owner: raj_sre)
- ask pen-team to rerun their sampling against staging/canary export (owner: support_julia)
- if retest confirms, rotate any affected keys and notify compliance (owner: maria_infosec)

raj_sre: i've scheduled canary rollout now (canary tag: exporter:v1.3.7-canary) — canary started at 2026-03-01T09:20:50Z.

sre-oncall: canary logs show TTL present in the exported JSON now. sample line:
`{"eventName":"GenerateDataKey","responseElements":{"PlaintextLength":32,"PlaintextTTL":0}}`

support_julia: pinged pen-team to retest against canary: @pen-team can you re-run sampling against the canary export and post results in this thread? ETA 48h.

pen-team: acknowledged — we'll re-run sampling and post evidence. prefer staging S3 path?

maria_infosec: severity note: compliance initially rated P1 due to retention appearance. Pending retest and evidence, downgrading to P3. will revert if pen confirms missing fields still.

dev_oleg: PR merged to canary. will promote to staging after pen confirmation.

raj_sre: follow-up: I also checked that CloudTrail exporter had no other field-normalization changes. scanning diffs now.

support_julia: attaching remediation checklist and retest instructions: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sec/kms-export-retest.md

sre-oncall: monitoring for any regressions on exporter CPU/memory during canary.

maria_infosec: assigning compliance advisory: I'll prepare the customer impact note draft and internal timeline.

support_julia: thanks all. will update thread when pen posts their retest evidence. :thumbsup:
